pmt_references.local_path: Reference Materials\PMT - RP 01 - Specific Heat Capacity - AQA Physics.pdf

coverage_decisions.pages: Complete practical method, diagram and safety notes
coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all ten individual PMT practical PDFs (32 pages), AQA required activities and relevant Study Rocket pages. Retained all ten complete methods and every circuit, ray, wave and thermal diagram. Added calibration beyond zero, axis-sensitive heat-capacity calculation, displacement-start bias, gate timing and controlled Leslie-cube measurement. Rejected PMT force–extension slope as 1/k, contradictory heat-capacity gradient rule, can filled below spout, extra hanging mass labelled constant total mass, current increased in volts, and hot water poured over a single cube face.
